result.question: When did Zebul become angry?

readings.answer: When he heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed.
readings.support: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.

assessments.reason: Verse 9:30 states that when Zebul heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he became angry, matching the key’s “hearing Gaal’s words about Abimelech.”

result.reason: Judges 9:30 explicitly says Zebul burned with anger when he heard Gaal’s words.
